_comment: Maps detector term IDs to friendly display names AND optional keyword overrides. Two forms: (1) just a string for the display name (uses detector's keywords); (2) an object with name + optional keywords array (overrides detector's keywords). When keywords are overridden here, this becomes the canonical tracker for that story and any detector sub-clusters whose matched videos overlap heavily with it get suppressed on the site. You can also add manual trackers that don't exist in the detector output by providing keywords + channelHandle.
